package.title: The essence of Vietnam, beyond the ordinary.

days.title: Arrival in Hanoi & Half Day City Tour
days.description: Arrive at Noi Bai International Airport, where you will be greeted by your driver and transferred to your hotel in Hanoi. After check-in, proceed for a half-day city tour covering iconic cultural and historical landmarks. Visit Ho Chi Minh Mausoleum, One Pillar Pagoda, Temple of Literature, Hoan Kiem Lake, and explore the vibrant Old Quarter streets. Overnight stay in Hanoi.
days.imageQuery: Hanoi Old Quarter lanterns, Hoan Kiem Lake

days.title: Ninh Binh, Hoa Lu, Tam Coc & Mua Cave Day Tour
days.description: After breakfast, depart from Hanoi for a full-day excursion to Ninh Binh, often called "Halong Bay on land" for its dramatic limestone landscapes. Visit Hoa Lu, the ancient capital, and enjoy a peaceful sampan boat ride along the Ngo Dong River in Tam Coc. Later, climb Mua Cave for breathtaking panoramic views of Tam Coc's river and karst formations. Return to Hanoi for overnight stay.
activities: Sampan boat ride in Tam Coc
days.imageQuery: Tam Coc sampan boat ride, Mua Cave panoramic view

days.title: Halong Bay Deluxe Day Cruise
days.description: Wake up with an early breakfast and depart for Halong Bay. Embark on a deluxe day cruise from Tuan Chau Marina, enjoying a welcome drink and buffet lunch with Vietnamese traditional food. Cruise past limestone islands like Dog Rock and Fighting Cock. Explore Sung Sot Cave, kayak or take a bamboo boat at Luon Cave, and visit Titop Island for swimming or hiking to its peak for panoramic bay views. Overnight stay in Hanoi.
activities: Kayaking or bamboo boat at Luon Cave
Swimming or hiking at Titop Island
days.imageQuery: Halong Bay limestone karsts, Titop Island panoramic view

days.title: Flight to Da Nang & Hoi An Lantern Boat Ride
days.description: Arrive in Hanoi and proceed to the airport for your onward flight to Da Nang. Upon arrival, transfer to your hotel and complete check-in. Afterwards, visit the famous Coconut Forest for a traditional basket boat ride. Continue to the charming ancient town of Hoi An, beautifully illuminated by lanterns. Explore vibrant streets and enjoy a scenic lantern boat ride along the Hoai River. Dinner is included. Overnight stay in Da Nang.
activities: Lantern boat ride on Hoai River

stay.roomType: Deluxe Double or Twin Room with Partial Seaview

days.imageQuery: Hoi An ancient town lanterns, Coconut Forest basket boat

days.title: Ba Na Hills Full Day Tour
days.description: After breakfast, proceed for a full-day excursion to Ba Na Hills, a famous hill station near Da Nang. Enjoy a scenic ride on one of the world's longest cable cars, offering breathtaking views. Visit the iconic Golden Bridge, explore the beautiful French Village with its European-style architecture, gardens, pagodas, and various attractions at Fantasy Park. A buffet lunch is included. Return to Da Nang for overnight stay.

days.title: Departure from Da Nang
days.description: After breakfast, check out from your hotel and proceed to Da Nang Airport for your return flight back to India, carrying beautiful memories of your Vietnam getaway. Safe travels!

Return to Hanoi for overnight stay.

Explore Sung Sot Cave, kayak or take a bamboo boat at Luon Cave, and visit Titop Island for swimming or hiking. Return to Hanoi for overnight stay.

days.description: Arrive at Bagdogra Airport and meet the transfer vehicle for the drive to Phuentsholing, approximately 180 km and five to six hours. Complete the immigration process on arrival. Phuentsholing is a lively commercial gateway at the foot of the Himalayan foothills, where Indian and Bhutanese cultures meet. Check in at the hotel and stay overnight in Phuentsholing.

days.description: After breakfast, drive approximately 180 km to Thimphu, a journey of around six to seven hours, and check in. Visit Buddha Point at Kuensel Phodrang for views over the valley, then see the King’s Memorial Chorten and the impressive Trashichhoedzong. Later, explore Thimphu Main Street, the market area and the Local Crafts Bazaar. Overnight in Thimphu.

Later visit Zilukha Nunnery, also known as Druthob Goemba, and learn about the nuns’ daily life and studies. Overnight in Thimphu.

days.title: GULMARG TO PAHALGAM (140 KMS / 4 HRS)
days.description: Drive to Pahalgam via Pampore saffron fields and Awantipora ruins. Check-in to resort by Lidder River. Evening at leisure walking along riverbank. Dinner & overnight stay at Hotel Heevan, Pahalgam.

days.title: PAHALGAM VALLEY SIGHTSEEING
days.description: Visit Betaab Valley, Aru Valley, and Chandanwari by local union cab. Afternoon river rafting at Lidder (optional). Dinner & overnight stay at Hotel Heevan, Pahalgam.

days.description: Return drive to Srinagar. Visit Mughal Gardens: Nishat Bagh, Shalimar Bagh, Chashme Shahi, and Shankaracharya Temple. Shopping at Lal Chowk for Pashmina and dry fruits. Dinner & overnight stay at Hotel Grand Boulevard, Srinagar.

days.title: Arrival in Phu Quoc – Explore Sunset Town
days.description: Upon arrival at Phu Quoc International Airport, you will be met by a local representative and transferred to your beachfront resort. Take photos, relax by the seaside, or enjoy coffee while watching the sunset. Dinner will be served at Sher-e-Punjab Indian Restaurant. Overnight in Phu Quoc.
days.imageQuery: Phu Quoc Sunset Town Kiss Bridge sunset

days.title: Island Hopping Adventure & Hon Thom Cable Car – Shared Tour
days.description: After breakfast at the resort, transfer to the southern port for a group island-hopping tour. Visit picturesque islands like Hon May Rut and Hon Thom, known for crystal-clear waters and vibrant marine life, perfect for swimming, snorkeling, and relaxing on pristine beaches. Experience a thrilling ride on the Hon Thom Cable Car, offering panoramic views of the An Thoi Archipelago. Lunch is included during the tour. Return to the resort for relaxation. Dinner at Maharaja GrandWorld Indian Restaurant. Overnight in Phu Quoc.

days.title: VinWonders Theme Park

Explore diverse themed zones, including thrilling water slides, enchanting fairy tale castles, exciting adventure games, 4D cinema, and cultural villages, offering entertainment for all ages. Lunch is on your own, with a variety of food outlets available within the park. Return to the hotel in the late afternoon. Dinner at Maharaja GrandWorld Indian Restaurant. Overnight in Phu Quoc.

days.title: Vinpearl Safari & GrandWorld Exploration
days.description: After breakfast at the resort, visit Vinpearl Safari, Vietnam’s first and largest open zoo, home to over 150 animal species. Discover attractions like Venice River, Teddy Bear Museum, Urban Park, and captivating outdoor street shows. Lunch is on your own during sightseeing. Dinner at Maharaja GrandWorld Indian Restaurant. Overnight in Phu Quoc.

package.title: The essence of Vietnam, beyond the ordinary.

days.title: Arrival in Hanoi & Half Day City Tour
days.description: Arrive at Noi Bai International Airport, where you will be greeted by your driver and transferred to your hotel in Hanoi. After check-in, proceed for a half-day city tour covering iconic cultural and historical landmarks. Visit Ho Chi Minh Mausoleum, One Pillar Pagoda, Temple of Literature, Hoan Kiem Lake, and explore the vibrant Old Quarter streets. Overnight stay in Hanoi.
days.imageQuery: Hanoi Old Quarter lanterns, Hoan Kiem Lake

days.title: Ninh Binh, Hoa Lu, Tam Coc & Mua Cave Day Tour
days.description: After breakfast, depart from Hanoi for a full-day excursion to Ninh Binh, often called "Halong Bay on land" for its dramatic limestone landscapes. Visit Hoa Lu, the ancient capital, and enjoy a peaceful sampan boat ride along the Ngo Dong River in Tam Coc. Later, climb Mua Cave for breathtaking panoramic views of Tam Coc's river and karst formations. Return to Hanoi for overnight stay.
activities: Sampan boat ride in Tam Coc
days.imageQuery: Tam Coc sampan boat ride, Mua Cave panoramic view

days.title: Halong Bay Deluxe Day Cruise
days.description: Wake up with an early breakfast and depart for Halong Bay. Embark on a deluxe day cruise from Tuan Chau Marina, enjoying a welcome drink and buffet lunch with Vietnamese traditional food. Cruise past limestone islands like Dog Rock and Fighting Cock. Explore Sung Sot Cave, kayak or take a bamboo boat at Luon Cave, and visit Titop Island for swimming or hiking to its peak for panoramic bay views. Overnight stay in Hanoi.
activities: Kayaking or bamboo boat at Luon Cave
Swimming or hiking at Titop Island
days.imageQuery: Halong Bay limestone karsts, Titop Island panoramic view

days.title: Flight to Da Nang & Hoi An Lantern Boat Ride
days.description: Arrive in Hanoi and proceed to the airport for your onward flight to Da Nang. Upon arrival, transfer to your hotel and complete check-in. Afterwards, visit the famous Coconut Forest for a traditional basket boat ride. Continue to the charming ancient town of Hoi An, beautifully illuminated by lanterns. Explore vibrant streets and enjoy a scenic lantern boat ride along the Hoai River. Dinner is included. Overnight stay in Da Nang.
activities: Lantern boat ride on Hoai River

stay.roomType: Deluxe Double or Twin Room with Partial Seaview

days.imageQuery: Hoi An ancient town lanterns, Coconut Forest basket boat

days.title: Ba Na Hills Full Day Tour
days.description: After breakfast, proceed for a full-day excursion to Ba Na Hills, a famous hill station near Da Nang. Enjoy a scenic ride on one of the world's longest cable cars, offering breathtaking views. Visit the iconic Golden Bridge, explore the beautiful French Village with its European-style architecture, gardens, pagodas, and various attractions at Fantasy Park. A buffet lunch is included. Return to Da Nang for overnight stay.

stay.roomType: Deluxe Double or Twin Room with Partial Seaview

days.imageQuery: Ba Na Hills Golden Bridge, French Village Ba Na Hills

days.title: Departure from Da Nang
days.description: After breakfast, check out from your hotel and proceed to Da Nang Airport for your return flight back to India, carrying beautiful memories of your Vietnam getaway. Safe travels!

reviewFlags.issue: Only 'Vietnam' was listed as destination in the summary, but itinerary covers specific cities. Expanded to specific cities for clarity.
Check-in baggage for DEL-DAD flight is stated as '0 kg', which is unusual and may require verification.

Accommodation details for Skylark Hotel (Hanoi) check-in/out dates (21 Nov - 24 Nov) contradict the itinerary's Hanoi stay dates (16 Nov - 18 Nov). Used itinerary's stated stay city and hotel name, but the dates are inconsistent.
Inclusions mention 'Hon Thom, Fansipan cable car ticket' and 'Hanoi - Sapa sleeper bus train ticket 2 way'. Hon Thom, Fansipan, and Sapa are not part of this itinerary.
Inclusions mention '1 night in Halong cruise 5*', but the itinerary describes a 'DELUXE DAY CRUISE' which is typically a day trip, not an overnight stay.
Exclusions list 'Flight tickets' and 'tcs charges', which directly contradict the 'FLIGHT COST ₹97,000' and 'Tax Included. ₹1,500 (TCS)' explicitly stated in the pricing section.
Exclusions list 'Early check in/ Late check out' and 'Hotel early check-in/late check-out charges', which contradict 'Early check-in included for Hanoi Hotel' in the inclusions.
Pricing mentions 'Tax Included. ₹1,500 (TCS)' but does not specify a GST rate. TCS is not GST.
Payment terms had slightly redundant or overlapping statements regarding balance payment and last-minute bookings. Consolidated for clarity.
Supplier name 'Junky Travels LLP' and contact details (UPI ID, Bank details, phone, email, website) were removed.

days.title: Arrival in Bagdogra and Transfer to Phuentsholing
days.description: Arrive at Bagdogra Airport and meet the transfer vehicle for the drive to Phuentsholing, approximately 180 km and five to six hours. Complete the immigration process on arrival. Phuentsholing is a lively commercial gateway at the foot of the Himalayan foothills, where Indian and Bhutanese cultures meet. Check in at the hotel and stay overnight in Phuentsholing.

days.title: Phuentsholing to Thimphu and Valley Sightseeing
days.description: After breakfast, drive approximately 180 km to Thimphu, a journey of around six to seven hours, and check in. Visit Buddha Point at Kuensel Phodrang for views over the valley, then see the King’s Memorial Chorten and the impressive Trashichhoedzong. Later, explore Thimphu Main Street, the market area and the Local Crafts Bazaar. Overnight in Thimphu.
activities: Walk around Thimphu Main Street and Local Crafts Bazaar

stay.hotel: Ariya (4-star standard), Turma Linca (4-star premium), or Le Méridien Thimphu (5-star)

days.imageQuery: Thimphu Buddha Point valley view Bhutan

days.title: Thimphu Museums, Monasteries and Cultural Sites
days.description: After breakfast, explore Thimphu Valley, including the National Library, the Institute for Zorig Chusum painting school, the Textile Museum and Simply Bhutan living museum. After lunch, drive to Pangri Zampa, an old monastery with a monastic school where students study Buddhist philosophy and astrology. Later visit Zilukha Nunnery, also known as Druthob Goemba, and learn about the nuns’ daily life and studies. Overnight in Thimphu.
activities: Visit the Institute for Zorig Chusum
Visit the Textile Museum and Simply Bhutan

stay.hotel: Ariya (4-star standard), Turma Linca (4-star premium), or Le Méridien Thimphu (5-star)

days.title: Thimphu to Punakha via Dochula Pass
days.description: After breakfast, drive from Thimphu to Punakha across Dochula Pass, noted for its prayer flags and views of the eastern Himalayas in clear weather. Continue to Chimi Lhakhang, the fertility temple, on a walk through paddy fields and villages; the round trip is described as about one and a half hours. Check in and visit Punakha Dzong at the meeting of two rivers, then explore the riverside village. Overnight in Punakha.
activities: Walk through villages and paddy fields to Chimi Lhakhang
days.imageQuery: Dochula Pass prayer flags Himalayan mountain views

days.title: Punakha to Paro via Simtokha Dzong
days.description: After breakfast, travel by scenic highway from Punakha to Paro, approximately 120 km and four and a half hours. En route, visit Simtokha Dzong, described as the country’s oldest fortress and now home to a school for Buddhist studies. On arrival in Paro, check in and, after lunch, visit Ta Dzong, now the National Museum, followed by a walk down to Rinpung Dzong to see its historic courtyard and wall paintings. Overnight in Paro.

stay.hotel: Thim Dorji (4-star standard), Kaachi Grand (4-star premium), or Le Méridien Paro, Riverfront (5-star)

days.imageQuery: Rinpung Dzong Paro Bhutan historic fortress

days.title: Tiger’s Nest Monastery or Haa Valley Excursion
days.description: After breakfast, the main itinerary is an approximately five-hour walk to Taktsang Monastery, or Tiger’s Nest, perched on a cliff above Paro Valley and regarded as a sacred Bhutanese site. The supplier also offers an alternative full-day excursion to Haa Valley via Chele-la Pass, visiting Haa Dzong, Lhakhang Karpo, Lhakhang Nagpo and Wangchulo Dzong, then returning to Paro. The Haa excursion is quoted as an additional INR 9,800. Overnight in Paro.

days.title: ARRIVAL SRINAGAR - LOCAL SIGHTSEEING
days.description: Meet & greet at Srinagar airport by driver. Transfer to luxury houseboat at Dal Lake. Afternoon Shikara ride visiting Floating Gardens, Char Chinar, and Nehru Park. Dinner & overnight stay at Houseboat (Dal Lake).

days.title: SRINAGAR TO SONAMARG DAY EXCURSION (85 KMS / 3 HRS ONE WAY)
days.description: After breakfast drive to Sonamarg (Meadow of Gold). Enjoy Thajiwas Glacier pony ride (direct payment). Return to Srinagar hotel in evening. Dinner & overnight stay at Hotel Grand Boulevard, Srinagar.
activities: SRINAGAR TO SONAMARG DAY EXCURSION (85 KMS / 3 HRS ONE WAY)

days.title: SRINAGAR - GULMARG (52 KMS / 2 HRS)
days.description: Post breakfast proceed to Gulmarg (Meadow of Flowers). Board Gulmarg Gondola Phase 1 & Phase 2 up to Apharwat Peak. Snow activities and golf course visit. Dinner & overnight stay at Hotel Pine Spring, Gulmarg.

days.title: GULMARG TO PAHALGAM (140 KMS / 4 HRS)
days.description: Drive to Pahalgam via Pampore saffron fields and Awantipora ruins. Check-in to resort by Lidder River. Evening at leisure walking along riverbank. Dinner & overnight stay at Hotel Heevan, Pahalgam.

days.title: PAHALGAM VALLEY SIGHTSEEING
days.description: Visit Betaab Valley, Aru Valley, and Chandanwari by local union cab. Afternoon river rafting at Lidder (optional). Dinner & overnight stay at Hotel Heevan, Pahalgam.

days.title: PAHALGAM TO SRINAGAR (95 KMS / 2
days.description: Return drive to Srinagar. Visit Mughal Gardens: Nishat Bagh, Shalimar Bagh, Chashme Shahi, and Shankaracharya Temple. Shopping at Lal Chowk for Pashmina and dry fruits. Dinner & overnight stay at Hotel Grand Boulevard, Srinagar.

days.title: DEPARTURE SRINAGAR AIRPORT

days.description: Arrive at Phu Quoc International Airport and meet the local representative before a private transfer to your beachfront resort for check-in and leisure. In the afternoon, explore Sunset Town’s Mediterranean architecture, sea-view cafes and iconic Kiss Bridge. Enjoy free time for seaside photographs, relaxation or coffee at sunset, followed by a dinner transfer to Sher-e-Punjab Indian Restaurant. Overnight in Phu Quoc.

days.description: After breakfast, transfer to the southern port for a shared island-hopping boat tour visiting picturesque islands such as Hon May Rut and Hon Thom. Swim, snorkel and relax on pristine beaches, with lunch included during the excursion. Ride the Hon Thom Cable Car for panoramic views of the An Thoi Archipelago, then return to the resort. Transfer to Maharaja GrandWorld Indian Restaurant for dinner.

Explore themed zones featuring water slides, fairy-tale castles, adventure games, a 4D cinema and cultural villages, with attractions for families and thrill seekers. Lunch is at your own expense at the park. Return to the hotel in the late afternoon, then transfer to Maharaja GrandWorld Indian Restaurant for dinner.

Lunch during sightseeing is at your own expense. Transfer to Maharaja GrandWorld Indian Restaurant for dinner, followed by an overnight stay in Phu Quoc.
